title: From Convolution π-Algebras to Rota-Baxter Hopf π-Algebras
content: This paper aims to formulate well-defined Rota-Baxter operators on Hopf π-algebras. To this end, we construct convolution algebras over π-graded structures, and further investigate the properties of antipodes and homomorphisms of Hopf π-algebras. Finally, we present the definition of Rota-Baxter Hopf π-algebras and construct valid examples.
